question: re-run B3_3_monday_dry_run with the two 2026-09-05 decisions applied as PROPOSALS: (a) band-derived exp_return kept as an UNVALIDATED INDICATOR stamped on the seal so hack6 is not empty; (b) hack2 marked manage-only in the runbook.
why_a_seal_was_not_attempted: the newest tracker vintage on disk is 2026-09-02 and MAX_TRACKER_AGE_SESSIONS is 2, so a seal today is correctly REFUSED. Running --refresh to manufacture a vintage was declined: a half-finished refresh leaves a FRESH-LOOKING partial vintage that Monday's seal would then price a book on, which is worse than an absent one.

proposal_a_indicator_mode.the_problem: hygiene-only implemented literally EMPTIES hack6 (15 -> 0) and replaces hack3's ten with a different five. The band's four return constants were the SOURCE of exp_return for those names, so retiring them sends every row back to the panel base rate and 799 of 810 then fail the long-book coherence floor, against 35 of 806 today. The floor is doing its job; nothing is left for it to read.
proposal_a_indicator_mode.the_proposal: a THIRD mode, AAT_BAND_MODE=indicator, OFF by default: hygiene gates admission exactly as under hygiene_only, the ratio is an admission rule in neither, and the band constant still populates exp_return -- stamped UNVALIDATED_INDICATOR on the row, in the book, and inside the seal's content_sha256.
proposal_a_indicator_mode.reading: the proposal COSTS NOTHING IN ADMISSIONS and BUYS THE LABEL. hack6 is not empty; the admitted sets are identical to today's live mode; the ratio stops being an admission rule; hygiene starts being one; and every exp_return that came off an eleven-year constant now says so.
what_it_does_NOT_claim: that the constants are right -- they came off a tape whose defects are documented and they sit below their own t 2 bar, which is why the label reads UNVALIDATED

that the identical admitted set proves the hygiene gate is inert. It fires: 33 names fail it and appear in every book's `fails` column. It removes names that were already failing something else on this vintage.

what_genuinely_changes_under_it.ratio_ge_4_bar: bars candidacy -> REPORTED as an indicator
what_genuinely_changes_under_it.note: the same three movements hygiene_only makes, pulling in opposite directions, which is why they are one switch and not three

proposal_a_indicator_mode.typo_safety: an unrecognised AAT_BAND_MODE value resolves to `returns`. A typo in a Railway variable must not half-apply a mode to a live book. Pinned by a test that sets `hygeine_only`.

proposal_b_hack2_manage_only.the_finding: contract.defaults_for branches on TRACKER_BOOKS = (hack3, hack4, hack6), so hack2 falls through to the EVENT defaults: horizon 3 sessions, min hold 0, profit_target_frac 0.025, on an `aggressive` 3% stop. The one armed book with NO minimum hold and a +2.5% target is the exact churn the minimum-hold build exists to stop -- and it is the book that opened five 1:8 shorts on 2026-09-04.
proposal_b_hack2_manage_only.instruction_proposed: mark hack2 MANAGE-ONLY before the Monday deploy re-arms entries, and leave it there until its contract defaults are decided
proposal_b_hack2_manage_only.not_done_in_code: nothing in this session set manage_only on hack2. Which defaults hack2 gets is Murat's call, not a session's, and two of the four possible disarms are RAILWAY VARIABLES a local process cannot see -- so the verification is at the service, not from the laptop.

entry_authority_as_measured.caveat: what a LOCAL process can see. Two disarms are Railway variables and this block refuses to guess them.

code_changed_in_the_terminal_repo.alpha/murat_rule.py: BAND_MODE_INDICATOR, BAND_MODES, the indicator branch of band_overlay (reusing the returns path verbatim rather than re-expressing its four silences), exp_return_validation on every scored row in EVERY mode
code_changed_in_the_terminal_repo.alpha/tracker.py: hygiene_gate_on() beside the narrower hygiene_only(); the eligibility chain, the $2 floor and the ratio bar now ask the GATE question rather than the MODE-NAME question
code_changed_in_the_terminal_repo.scripts/prediction_book.py: band_mode in the seal provenance block and exp_return_validation on every holding, both INSIDE content_sha256
code_changed_in_the_terminal_repo.scripts/monday_dry_run.py: --mode indicator, --compare over three modes, hygiene count printed for every mode that runs the gate
code_changed_in_the_terminal_repo.tests_smoke_band_mode.py: 20 new checks incl. the typo-resolves-to-returns case

the_bug_this_avoided: gating the eligibility chain on hygiene_only() alone would have silently dropped the hygiene exclusion the moment the third mode was switched on -- a guard that stops firing because a neighbouring constant changed. hygiene_gate_on() asks the question the chain actually has.
